attempts.diagnosis: Unsealed stale SQLite WAL and shared-memory files became visible after sealing. Main DB still matched its seal. Cause of reappearance NOT_ESTABLISHED; old files remain unchanged.
attempts.adaptation: Separate runtime journals from sealed standalone evidence; require nonbusy checkpoint, worker exit, SQLite backup, preclose-state agreement, integrity, DELETE mode and fsync.

tests.finite_model: Two capacities(1,2), two one-unit obligations, six declared actions, horizon3; other schedules sampled.

confounds: Single observation per cell, fixed method order and shared host/cache; no speed significance.
Shared transactional machinery and verifier; comparison isolates no general AI advantage.
Source-visible preregistered transfers are held out from the base demonstration, not blind population sampling.
Attempt2 follows an observed evidence-finalization failure; both attempts retained, not pooled.
Preparation, integration, verification/reporting CPU, peak memory, rates and business costs remain unknown.

limitations: Synthetic local JSON outputs are not printed goods or customer delivery.
Primary and backup are logical routes on shared local infrastructure.
Process failures and finite traces do not prove power-loss durability or universal exactly-once delivery.
The old stale-sidecar reappearance mechanism remains unestablished; finalization mitigation is scoped to the tested evidence boundary.
AI performance NOT_RUN; protocol stub is not a model result.
No real customer authority, supplier qualification, paying customer or commercial savings established.
next_rehearsal_evidence: Genuine order authority and complete journal/cutoff with amendments and cancellations.
Explicit activation/disclosure permissions and a qualified isolated primary/backup execution environment.
Provider-confirmed capacity/window/dependencies and agreed idempotency/reconciliation behavior.
Independent acceptance of actual outputs under agreed clocks/deadlines.
Measured preparation/operation/verification labor and complete rates/obligations; bounded stop/reversal plan.

additional_fresh_verification.purpose: Separate executor session verifies that the finalized evidence remains stable.
